Day Three: Travel west to Kyoto and settle in a machiya house

Day Four: Explore the Gion district and perhaps see a geisha

Day Five: Take a bus to Nara and feed the friendly deer

Day Six: Head to Hiroshima via shinkansen and reflect at Peace Memorial Park
Visit Miyajima Island and the floating torii of Itsukushima

Day Seven: Return to Tokyo and shop in Harajuku for quirky fashion
